name: Pinball machine
summary: This EA implements a 'Pinball' breakout strategy that trades price bounces off dynamic support/resistance levels. It identifies consolidation ranges and enters trades when price breaks out with momentum, similar to a pinball bouncing off bumpers. The system uses pending orders and momentum confirmation to capture directional moves from range expansions.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了'弹珠'突破策略，交易价格从动态支撑/阻力位的反弹。它识别盘整区间，在价格带突破动量时入场，类似于弹珠从碰撞台弹开。系统使用挂单和动量确认来捕捉区间扩张后的方向性走势。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用突破策略，核心概念是识别价格盘整区间后在突破方向入场。入场条件基于价格突破前期高点或低点，并结合动量指标确认突破有效性。出场条件包括固定止盈止损以及突破失败后的反转出场。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例手数计算方式。资金管理方面，该EA设置了止损但可能缺少动态调整机制。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于典型的区间突破交易系统，但需注意假突破带来的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a breakout strategy where the core concept is identifying price consolidation ranges and entering in the breakout direction. Entry conditions are based on price breaking above previous highs or below previous lows, combined with momentum indicator confirmation to validate the breakout. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, as well as reversal exits when breakouts fail. Position sizing uses either fixed lots or account-balance-proportional lot calculation. Money management incorporates stop-losses but may lack dynamic adjustment mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is clear, representing a typical range-breakout trading system, though the risk of false breakouts should be noted.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，区间突破是经过验证的交易方法
使用挂单入场，减少了滑点影响
设有止损止盈，基本风险控制到位
pros_en: Clear strategy logic — range breakout is a proven trading methodology
Uses pending orders for entry, reducing slippage impact
Includes stop-loss and take-profit, providing basic risk control
cons: 缺乏假突破过滤机制，容易在震荡市中被反复止损
未包含点差过滤，在高点差环境下可能频繁亏损
仓位管理较为简单，未根据市场波动动态调整
cons_en: Lacks false breakout filtering, prone to repeated stop-outs in choppy markets
No spread filter included, may incur frequent losses in high-spread environments
Position sizing is simplistic without dynamic adjustment based on market volatility
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈和仓位调整，适应市场波动变化
添加成交量或波动率过滤条件以减少假突破入场
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit and position sizing to adapt to changing market volatility
Incorporate volume or volatility filters to reduce entries on false breakouts

risk_points: 缺乏点差过滤可能在不利条件下造成额外损失
固定止损未考虑市场波动性变化，可能在大波动时过小
risk_points_en: Lack of spread filter may cause additional losses under unfavorable conditions
Fixed stop-loss doesn't account for market volatility changes, potentially too tight during high volatility
